Committee: County and Municipal Government
Sponsor: Alexander
Analyst: Vee Mosely
Date: 03/07/2022
FISCAL NOTE
House Bill 389 as introduced could decrease receipts to municipalities by an undetermined amount dependent upon the amount of municipal traffic fines and penalties collected in excess of 10% of the municipality's general operating budget. This bill could correspondingly increase receipts to the Crime Victim's Compensation Fund and the Fair Trail Tax Fund, equally, by an undetermined amount dependent on the amount of municipal traffic fines and penalties collected in excess of 10% of the municipalities most recently completed year's budget and subsequently transferred to these funds, as provided by this bill.
Reed Ingram, Chair
County and Municipal Government
